verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's GitHub README documents a first-party screenshot feature that captures page screenshots during crawling, so the core capability exists. The evidence does not say whether captures cover the full page or can target a selected element or area. The Full-Page Scanning feature is about scrolling to load dynamic content, not screenshot scope, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit full-page screenshot evidence, element/region-selected screenshot capability, detailed docs on screenshot options, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture a screenshot of a full page or a specific selected area

citations.quote: Screenshots: Capture page screenshots during crawling for debugging or analysis.
